title: Revocation target coverage
preconditions: trusted policy and authenticated artifacts require coverage of the full applicable dependency set
the candidate omits a required target class or lacks a usable required source view
steps: Omit one required target class or source from dependency coverage while every included view appears current; supply an unauthenticated view as an empty success.
repeat independently for protocol versions agent-or-bridge builds platform profiles policies attestation identities verifier keys and game-or-runtime manifests
a stale required view cannot be replaced by a current view of an unrelated class or scope
invariants: M1-015 V01: Every architectural target class has one declared authority/scope/match/retention rule; omission of a required class fails closed
M1-015 V05: Unknown, expired, unauthenticated or incomplete view is unavailable/unsupported, never an empty success or fabricated revocation
M1-015 V08: Staleness of any required view defeats authorization even if every other view is current
residual_risk: Trusted complete dependency derivation and safe bounded retention are prerequisite mechanisms.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
